user.title: Log in to your Panasonic account
user.description:
1. Open this link in a browser that has its developer tools open (Chrome/Edge: F12 or Cmd+Option+I, Console tab): {authorize_url}
2. Log in with your Panasonic ID (the account used in the "スマホで洗濯" / Panasonic Smart Laundry app).
3. After logging in the page stays blank and the console shows a line like `Failed to launch 'auth0://...?code=...'`. This is expected.
4. Copy that whole console line (or just the `auth0://...` address) and paste it below. The code is single-use and expires quickly, so paste it right away.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in again
reauth_confirm.description:
The login expired.

3. After logging in the page stays blank and the console shows a line like `Failed to launch 'auth0://...?code=...'`. This is expected.
4. Copy that whole console line (or just the `auth0://...` address) and paste it below. The code is single-use and expires quickly, so paste it right away.
